name: Offboarding - create checklist
description: Two-page n8n form that reads the internal General tools Confluence page (2076311575), builds a per-person offboarding tool checklist xlsx in the OneDrive Offboardings folder, registers it, and DMs each access owner on Slack.

parameters.formDescription: Generates the tool checklist spreadsheet from the live General tools Confluence page and DMs each access owner on Slack.

values.option: On a specific date and time
At the end of the working day on a specific date

options.formDescription: One row per access owner on the General tools page. Change an email to reassign a person for this offboarding only. Untick a person to skip pinging them. Leave an email empty and nobody is pinged for their tools.

value.file_url: ={{ $('Create edit share link').first().json.link?.webUrl || $('Upload checklist to OneDrive').first().json.webUrl }}

parameters.responseText:
=

Checklist created

{{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.fileName }} is in the Offboardings folder, shared with the assigned access owners, and they have been DM'd on Slack.

Open the checklist  |  {{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.toolCount }} tools  |  offboarding can start: {{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.offboardingStart }}

Google Drive files shared with {{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.personEmail }}

Send this link to the team that worked with them so they can remove access from anything it turns up. Each person sees only the files they can access, so it needs to go to the whole team, not just one person.

https://drive.google.com/drive/search?q=sharedwith:{{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.personEmail.replace('@', '%40') }}

Owners with no email set, so nobody is pinged for their tools: {{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.ownersWithoutEmail || 'none' }}
Note links written as clickable hyperlinks: {{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.hyperlinkCount }}{{ $('Build offboarding record').first().json.multiLinkNotes > 0 ? ' (' + $('Build offboarding record').first().json.multiLinkNotes + ' note(s) had several links and stayed as plain text)' : '' }}

activeVersion.name: Read General tools (internal) and Note [internal]
activeVersion.description: Fetches the internal General tools page (2076311575). Note comes from the Note [internal] column (falls back to Note); Scope and Access owner also match their [internal] headers. Checked locally: same 124 rows, owners and note links as the old public-page parse.
